text:
ana (People Ops): quick thread  candidate for Product PM requested extra processing time during whiteboard tasks (adds 15-20m between questions) due to a documented neurodiversity accommodation. also prefers interviews in afternoon (avoids stimulant med window). can we adapt schedule? cc @sam @lee @talia

sam (Recruiter): thanks ana. candidate is in MST and prefers local afternoon (1pm-4pm MST). we have interviewers in PST and CET. putting options: start 12pm PST / 8pm CET (tight for europe) or move 2pm PST / 11pm CET (late). opinion?

lee (Hiring Manager): i'd rather avoid asking european panelists to stay past 9pm. can we compress tech tasks to fewer segments but allow 20m buffer for each? also fine with 12pm PST start.

talia (Interview Ops): suggestion: split loop into two focused blocks 12:00-14:00 PST (behavior + product + light design) then async pairing task to submit later. that reduces synchronous time for CET. we can reserve Quiet Room and mark 15-min breaks between interviews for processing.

sam (Recruiter): candidate confirmed they can do 12pm PST start and needs 15min processing after each whiteboard question. they also requested interview prompts in advance if possible.

ana (People Ops): small correction: i'm ana not nana :)

ana (People Ops): (oops typo) ana here. I will draft the calendar note. proposed calendar snippet:
```
Please note: Candidate has approved accomodation for additional processing time. Please allow 15m between technical questions and avoid scheduling before 12:00 PST. Interview materials will be shared in advance.
```

lee (Hiring Manager): good. also please provide a headset/microphone for candidate loaner in case of audio clarity needs.

it-bot: IT ticket IT-9573 created: candidate loaner headset & Quiet Room reservation (Conf F1) 11:45-14:30. ETA procurement 24h.

security-bot: Visitor pre-reg: https://badge.redwood.example/visitor?ref=2198765432  Note: candidate arrives via train 11:50 local, escort requested.

sam (Recruiter): i'll share interview prompts 48h in advance and confirm travel. will mark pairing as asynchronous deliverable (sandbox link + 24h window).

ana (People Ops): final logistics: 12:00-14:00 PST in Conf F1, Quiet Room 11:45-12:15 for prep, 15-min buffers, headset loaner available, pairing task is async. expense note: meals covered per policy. Closing: i'll send invites and accommodation note. thanks team! :white_check_mark:
